bio:

His unerring focus on selecting next-generation investment fields with the greatest development potential has earned record-breaking returns for investors. As a Foundation Member of the World Economic Forum, Liu actively shares ideas with global business and political minds at the annual Davos meetings, offering his unique understanding of Greater China. His impressive European connections include membership in the Monaco Ambassadors Club and distinction as the first Chinese member of the Yacht Club of Monaco, where he engages in “yacht club diplomacy” to connect Monaco with prominent Chinese yacht clubs.

He has facilitated sister-city relationships between Chinese cities and European counterparts, including Dunhuang with Nice. His American ties are equally substantial, serving as a longtime member of the Atlantic Council of U.S. and helping establish sister-city relations between San Francisco and Shanghai. Liu believes in sharing success with communities worldwide, serving as an honorary board member of the Flying Angels Foundation and as Special Director to the China Foundation for Disabled Persons, an organization praised by Chinese President Xi Jinping for improving the lives of millions of underprivileged Chinese citizens.

name: Denis Krysanov
headline: President of Heologic Group Founder & Originator of Digital Geochemistry
bio:
Technology Entrepreneur | Earth Intelligence & AI Innovator

Denis Krysanov is an international technology entrepreneur, author and innovator developing new ways to understand the Earth, anticipate its changes and discover its resources more intelligently.

He is the founder of the concept of Digital Geochemistry and author of “Digital Geochemistry: The New Language of The Earth”, which introduces a new approach to transforming signals from the Earth into structured digital information that can be analyzed at scale. This concept has become the foundation of his research and the integration of Earth data with artificial intelligence.

As President of Heologic Group, Denis leads the development of technologies and AI solutions for interpreting signals originating beneath the Earth’s surface. His work includes a functioning AI system for identifying patterns associated with earthquakes and volcanic activity, as part of a broader vision of Earth Intelligence — using AI to better understand how our planet works and anticipate its behavior.

Denis is also developing the concept of localized energy discovery: using advanced exploration technologies to identify energy resources where they are actually needed. The vision is to enable the development of communities, industrial parks, data centers and remote regions—from Alaska to Africa—where limited access to energy has historically restricted economic and human development.

At the center of his work is one idea: the Earth is continuously producing information; humanity needs better ways to read it. AI can help us understand those signals, anticipate natural events and discover the resources needed to build the future.

In 2016, Dr. Soliman was single author of a book called “Pain Management by Prolotherapy and Perineural Injection Therapy”, working nowadays on the second edition, and she has many publications as well.

In 2020, she was chosen to be one among the Top 50 most influential women in Egypt.

In 2023, she was honored by his excellency, minister of high education and scientific research, for putting Egypt on the international list of the American Academy / Association of Orthopedic Medicine (AAOM).

In 2025, she was honored again by his excellency minister of high education and scientific research, and his excellency the advisor to the president of the Egyptian republic for health and preventive measures, for being the Section Chief of the American Academy / Association of Orthopedic Medicine in Europe and Africa.

name: Nic Careem
headline: Social Entrepreneur | Humanitarian | International Community Leader
bio:
Nic Careem is a British social entrepreneur, humanitarian and internationally respected community leader whose work has, for more than thirty years, focused on building stronger communities through education, partnership and social innovation. His career has been dedicated to bringing together people from different cultures, faiths and sectors to create practical solutions that promote equality, opportunity and lasting social impact.
He is the founder and custodian of the House of Commons Nelson Mandela Legacy Book, one of the world’s most significant private collections of handwritten tributes to Nelson Mandela. Created in 1999 to commemorate Mandela’s historic visit to the UK Parliament, the leather-bound volume contains more than 700 personal messages from heads of state, parliamentarians, Nobel Peace Prize laureates, global business leaders, artists, sports personalities, faith leaders and young people. The collection stands as a unique historical record celebrating Mandela’s values of reconciliation, justice, dignity and forgiveness.
Building upon this remarkable legacy, Nic established the Letter to Nelson Mandela Initiative, an international educational programme encouraging young people aged 9–18 to become active global citizens by reflecting on Mandela’s principles and expressing their own vision for a fairer, more compassionate and sustainable world. The initiative promotes leadership, empathy, critical thinking and civic responsibility through the power of education.
Throughout his career, Nic has conceived and led numerous initiatives addressing community cohesion, anti-hate education, youth development, public health, social inclusion and international cooperation. His collaborative approach has enabled him to work with parliamentarians, diplomats, educational institutions, charitable foundations, healthcare organisations and business leaders across the United Kingdom and internationally.

Nic is also the founder of Blue Sky Network and Blue Sky Village, ambitious social enterprise initiatives designed to address poverty by integrating education, healthcare, employment, skills development and sustainable economic opportunity.

These projects reflect his long-held belief that meaningful partnerships between governments, businesses, universities and civil society can deliver transformational change for disadvantaged communities.

His commitment to public service extends across numerous charitable and civic initiatives, including projects recognising frontline healthcare workers, supporting anti-hate education and creating opportunities for young people. His ability to unite diverse organisations behind a common purpose has earned him the respect of leaders across many sectors.

Today, Nic continues to develop international collaborations inspired by the life and legacy of Nelson Mandela. Through exhibitions, educational programmes, publications and global partnerships, he seeks to ensure that Mandela’s ideals continue to inspire future generations to build societies founded on justice, respect, compassion and service.
Vision
To create a world in which education, collaboration and compassion empower every individual to reach their full potential, while building stronger, more inclusive communities across nations and generations.
Guiding Principle

“The greatest legacy we can leave is not measured by personal achievement, but by the lives we inspire, the opportunities we create, and the hope we leave for future generations.”
Nic Careem

bio:
Kevin Kane is a founder-CEO, technologist, and deep-tech entrepreneur working at the intersection of cybersecurity and post-quantum cryptography. He is the CEO and co-founder of American Binary, founded in 2019, where he has led the development and deployment of post-quantum encrypted computer networking technologies aligned with the NSA’s CNSA 2.0 standards, which establish U.S. government requirements for encryption designed to remain secure in a future shaped by quantum computing. His mission is focused on protecting government and commercial enterprise networks that underpin the global economy.

Under his leadership, American Binary launched Ambit Client, a post-quantum encrypted VPN and network protocol designed to secure national security and commercial enterprise environments using CNSA 2.0-aligned post-quantum cryptography. The company’s work was highlighted by Booz Allen Hamilton in its 2024 report identifying the Top 10 Emerging Technologies relevant to the U.S. Department of Defense, and in 2025 American Binary was integrated into the Oracle Defense Ecosystem.

Prior to American Binary, Kevin founded and led multiple AI and machine-learning deep-tech companies, building teams and organizations that applied machine learning-driven analytics and models in the field of quantitative finance. He holds a graduate degree from Seoul National University Graduate School of International Studies.

name: Lexye Aversa
headline: IASC Strategic Advisor for Global Alliances & Humanitarian Initiatives
bio:
With an extraordinary international background spanning diplomacy, humanitarian engagement, luxury hospitality, multi-tiered relations in the corporate arena, philanthropy, media, and global event production, Lexye Aversa brings to the IASC World Changers ecosystem a rare combination of intellectual elegance, institutional experience, intercultural fluency, and visionary global connectivity.
Her remarkable accomplishments encompass mounting the World Strategic Forum in Palm Beach which relocated to Coral Gables, handling every nuance of production, while interviewing Heads of State, multi-national CEO’s, Prime Ministers, Ambassadors, influential public figures and dignitaries from all continents, building bridges between communities, countries and cultures. Known as a “cosmic connector”, Lexye Aversa is a dynamic multilingual communicator fluent in English, Italian, French, and Spanish. Her international network spans the globe with a special focus on Europe, the Gulf Region, Israel, the Americas, Africa and Asia, with endeavors in play across multiple sectors including tourism, media, finance, aerospace, innovation, healthcare, philanthropy, and strategic advisory.
Born holding a microphone in one hand and magic wand in the other, Lexye Aversa truly calls the world her stage. Brandeis University graduate Cum Laude, Lexye’s theatrical roots inspired her talents of performance into real life pageantry with purpose — producing unforgettable events from royal banquets in Vienna’s Hofburg Palace and medieval festivals in Visconti Castles to corporate Olympics on snow-covered Mount Etna and exclusive gatherings in the Sicilian villa featured in The Godfather films.
For more than 4 decades, she has orchestrated high-level conferences, global forums, humanitarian galas, and strategic initiatives involving multinational scions of industry, government figures, royal families, entrepreneurs, institutional leaders, and media networks. After years operating tours and charter travel programs for AAA and international companies, she launched Professional Touch International Travel and expanded with LexAventures LLC in 2019. An award-winning Global Event Architect, Media Host, and Visionary, her first corporate client was Dun & Bradstreet, laying world-recognized foundations for excellence, delivering “Services which Surpass Our Promises” (became the company mantra). Her inaugural diplomatic engagement was liaison for the Sister City Program with Mayor Koch celebrating New York City in Madrid. She found time to establish All Travel Services Institute, certified by the New York State Board of Education, devised the curriculum and course syllabus, and was chief instructor.
Her worldwide “rolodex” is infinite, with deeply rooted connections to Italy, encompassing Vatican-related environments and international hospitality diplomacy which further strengthens the mission of IASC World Changers to create meaningful global alliances rooted in trust, ethics, integrity, and human flourishing. This profound intertwined Italian heritage emanates from her husband Gianni Aversa (from Sorrento), prominent hotelier at the prestigious Hotel and Sporting Club Villa Pamphili, where he hosted Seria A soccer teams (as a former formidable player in the professional Futbal circuit) and countless Vatican related conclaves. Beyond her husband’s vision, Lexye Aversa has shared her knowledge of and devotion to Italy with thousands of travelers. Her proprietary presentation “Italy on Your Doorstep” shares how the gifts of the Romans and Italians influence our daily lives, consciously and subconsciously! She considers The Eternal City her spiritual and cultural home.
Lexye Aversa was featured as “Best Global Event Planner” on FOX TV’s Best of South Florida. She was media host for LEX Travel, radio broadcast series transporting listeners to LEXtraordinary Destinations, and subsequently filmed a TV Pilot in Rome, blending travel, culture, history, and storytelling. Lexye is affectionately known as the “Cosmic Connector” — bringing people, ideas, and inspiration together. She served as Secretary of Women’s Chamber of Commerce of Palm Beach County and on a myriad of Boards, including Il Circolo, the Italian Cultural Society in Palm Beach. She is the recipient of multiple humanitarian awards, with a spotlight on the Signet Award presented in Sweden’s Town Hall Gold Room, emulating the ceremony and banquet of the previous night’s Nobel Prize to Nelson Mandela, with whom she bonded at her hotel.
Beyond international tourism, her passion lies within humanitarian and philanthropic initiatives addressing anti-trafficking, anti-Semitism, the Holocaust, education, earth preservation, poverty, and the eradication of injustice for women and children. Lexye Aversa’s annual Holiday Cabaret benefiting “A Safe Haven for Newborns” is instrumental in eliminating infant abandonment.
As Strategic Advisor for Global Alliances & Humanitarian Initiatives, Lexye Aversa will contribute to the international expansion of the IASC World Changers vision by fostering new institutional relationships, humanitarian collaborations, cultural diplomacy initiatives, and strategic partnerships aligned with the ethical and interdisciplinary mission of the organization.
Her appointment also reflects the spirit of the upcoming Multiverse of Trust in the Quantum Age — an invitation-only international gathering bringing together scientists, diplomats, innovators, entrepreneurs, artists, philosophers, spiritual leaders, and institutions to explore the future of humanity in the age of artificial intelligence, quantum technologies, regenerative science, and human-centered innovation.
As Master of Ceremonies for the Vatican gathering on 22 October 2026, Lexye Aversa will illuminate the experience designed not simply as a conference, but as a curated high-trust environment dedicated to dialogue, wisdom, ethical progress, and global cooperation.
Her arrival within the IASC World Changers family represents another milestone toward strengthening a global network committed to peace, flourishing, scientific diplomacy, and the responsible evolution of technology in service of humanity.
In welcoming Lexye Aversa, IASC World Changers celebrates not only an accomplished international figure, but also a woman whose life and work embody the values of service, dialogue, culture, and selfless humanitarian commitment that stand at the heart of the organization’s mission.

name: Brittany Kaiser
headline: Chief Executive Officer and Board Member AlphaTON Capital
bio:
Brittany Kaiser is the Chief Executive Officer of AlphaTON Capital (Nasdaq: ATON), a company bridging institutional capital with the Telegram-based crypto ecosystem.

She is an internationally recognized data rights activist, author, and whistleblower best known for her pivotal role in exposing the Cambridge Analytica and Facebook data scandal. As a former director of business development at Cambridge Analytica, she came forward in 2018 to reveal how millions of Facebook users’ personal data had been harvested without consent and used to influence elections around the world, including the 2016 U.S. presidential race and the Brexit referendum. Her testimony before the UK Parliament, the U.S. Congress, and European policymakers positioned her at the center of the global debate on data privacy, democracy, and the future of technology. She is featured prominently in the Academy Award–nominated Netflix documentary The Great Hack, which brought worldwide attention to the dangers of unchecked data exploitation. Following her whistleblowing, Kaiser co-founded the Own Your Data Foundation, a nonprofit dedicated to digital literacy and training young people to protect their data. She also launched the #OwnYourData movement, advocating for individuals to take control of their personal information and for governments to legislate stronger protections in the digital age. In addition to her advocacy, she is the author of Targeted: My Inside Story of Cambridge Analytica and How Trump, Brexit and Facebook Broke Democracy, where she details her personal journey and offers an insider perspective on the misuse of big data in politics. Kaiser has served as a Sub-Committee member of the Congressional Select Committee on Blockchain, Fintech and Digital Innovation, having co-authored and helped pass over 40 laws on data ownership, digital assets and blockchain technology. She sits on the board of, or as an advisor to, many companies across industries, working on data ethics, strategy and privacy protocols.

A renowned thought leader and public speaker, she is represented by CAA and has spoken at prestigious events held at the United Nations, the European and British Parliaments, the G20, and WebSummit, as well as guest lecturing at universities such as Harvard, Oxford and Columbia. She holds an undergraduate and MA with honors in International Relations from the University of Edinburgh, an LLM in International Human Rights Law from the University of London Birkbeck College of Law, and an MPhil in International Law from Middlesex University.

His work demonstrates how historical knowledge, when properly documented and transmitted, becomes a bridge between generations and a foundation for cultural continuity.

At the IASC World Changers Summit – Multiverse of Trust, Count degli Uberti will lead a special session dedicated to the future of the Auxiliary Sciences of History in the age of artificial intelligence, digital archives, blockchain verification, and digital twins. The discussion will explore how emerging technologies can strengthen the preservation, accessibility, authentication, and transmission of historical knowledge while safeguarding authenticity and institutional credibility.

His participation reflects a central principle of the Multiverse of Trust initiative: that trust is built not only through technological innovation, but also through the preservation of memory, identity, provenance, and the integrity of human knowledge across generations.

Session Theme
From Historical Memory to Digital Trust: Preserving Identity, Heritage, and Authenticity in the Quantum Era.

Under the coordination of Count Pier Felice degli Uberti, the session will feature distinguished experts examining the future of genealogy, heraldry, documentary sciences, historical archives, artificial intelligence, and digital twin technologies, demonstrating how the preservation of humanity’s collective memory remains fundamental to the flourishing of future generations.

Dr. Christopoulos is also actively involved in the global medical community, conducting neuromodulation workshops and training programs for healthcare professionals worldwide. These initiatives aim to disseminate knowledge and best practices in neuromodulation, fostering a collaborative approach to brain health.

For consultations or more information about neuromodulation therapies, Dr. Christopoulos can be reached through the SOZO Brain Center’s official channels.

name: Alberto Michelini
headline: Journalist and former Member of the European Parliament
bio:
Alberto Michelini is an Italian journalist and politician, born on July 25, 1941, in Rome. He began his career in journalism in the late 1970s as a host and special correspondent for the RAI news programme TG1. Michelini was one of the first to interview Pope John Paul II and later wrote ten books about his pontificate. He also documented the Pope’s assassination attempt in 1981.

In 1984, Michelini was elected to the European Parliament as a member of the Christian Democracy (DC) party, and he was re-elected in 1989. During his tenure, he served on various committees, including the Committee on the Environment, Public Health and Consumer Protection, the Committee on Development and Cooperation, and the Committee on Culture, Youth, Education, Information and Sport.

Michelini was also a member of the Chamber of Deputies in Italy, serving from 1987 to 2006. He was involved in the Segni Pact and later joined Forza Italia. In 2006, he left Forza Italia due to his refusal to support the candidacy of Gianni Alemanno as Mayor of Rome, giving his support instead to the incumbent Mayor Walter Veltroni.

Beyond his political career, Michelini has been active in various initiatives and organizations, including serving as a representative for the G8 Africa Action Plan and participating in events related to peace and international cooperation.

headline: Ukrainian politician, former Prime Minister
bio:
Yulia Tymoshenko is a prominent Ukrainian politician, born in Dnipro, Ukraine. Before politics, she was a successful businesswoman in the energy sector, earning the nickname “Gas Princess.” She entered politics in 1996, becoming a key figure during the 2004 Orange Revolution, which led to the annulment of a fraudulent election.

Tymoshenko served as Ukraine’s Prime Minister twice: from 2005 to 2005 and from 2007 to 2010, becoming the first female to hold the position. In 2011, she was convicted on charges related to a gas deal with Russia, but many considered the trial politically motivated. She was released in 2014 following the Euromaidan protests.

Tymoshenko ran for president in 2010, 2014, and 2019 but never won. Her political career has been marked by her advocacy for Ukraine’s European integration and national sovereignty.

name: Benedetta Audia
headline: Principal of International Development LLC
bio:
Professor Benedetta Audia is the Principal of International Development LLC, a firm that advises private sector companies on international development and business strategy, while also providing counsel to multilateral organizations, non-governmental organizations, and government entities. Widely recognized as the foremost expert on United Nations and World Bank procurement and implementation arrangements, Professor Audia brings a holistic understanding of the complex legal, operational, and institutional architecture of the international development system. Her expertise includes due diligence, investigations, fund disbursement, project design, and dispute resolution.

Prior to founding International Development LLC, Professor Audia was a Partner at DLA Piper, where she led the firm’s international development practice. Before that, she spent nearly two decades at the United Nations, where she was instrumental in designing the legal frameworks for thousands of multimillion-dollar projects across developing countries. Her role frequently involved leading negotiations with senior government officials to operationalize large-scale, cross-sectoral initiatives.

Earlier in her career, Professor Audia worked in mergers and acquisitions at Gianni, Origoni, Grippo, Cappelli & Partners, advising on a wide range of domestic and cross-border transactions. In December 2024, she was appointed Legal Advisor to the Permanent Representative of the Sovereign Military Order of Malta to the United Nations.

A seasoned negotiator with deep experience across jurisdictions, Professor Audia advises on strategic legal structuring, risk mitigation, and financial integrity in development programming. She is frequently called upon by senior leadership to guide the resolution of high-stakes issues that demand both legal precision and systems-level insight.

Her authoritative command of procurement and grant disbursement mechanisms—including vendor sanctions, bid protests, contract awards, and regulatory frameworks—has positioned her as a trusted advisor in complex disputes and international arbitrations spanning sectors such as infrastructure, health, procurement, and the environment.

Professor Audia has trained thousands of United Nations personnel, government officials, and non-state actors on procurement systems, implementation frameworks, and the operational dimensions of international development. A prolific speaker and writer, she regularly addresses themes at the intersection of law, technology, and development, including artificial intelligence, blockchain, and public procurement.

She currently serves as Professor of Procurement in International Development at George Washington University, Professor of Contracting in International Development at Fordham University, and Professor of Law at LUISS Guido Carli University. She is also the co-author of three recent books on blockchain and the law, pandemic response, and fashion law. Professor Audia was recognized for her innovative leadership by Corporate Counsel through the Women, Influence & Power in Law Awards.

In addition to her professional and academic roles, Professor Audia serves on the Board of Directors of both the New York City Opera and Global Citizen, where she contributes her strategic insight and commitment to advancing the arts, global equity, and sustainable development.

bio:

She is best known for her ongoing Wasteland project, which explores the environmental impact of plastic waste through installations and actions around the globe. Central to this project is the creation of the Garbage Patch State, a provocative artistic statement that highlights the ocean’s plastic pollution. The Garbage Patch State was officially “declared” in 2013 at UNESCO headquarters in Paris, marking the inception of a new, imagined nation symbolizing the environmental crisis caused by plastic waste.

Finucci’s monumental installations have been featured at international events, including the Venice Art Biennale (2013), MAXXI Museum in Rome (2014), Milan Expo (2015), and the Roman Forum (2018). Her works, such as Climatesaurus and H2o, aim to raise awareness about the urgent need to address ocean pollution and environmental destruction. In 2018, Finucci, as the Head of State of the Garbage Patch State, signed the UN Agenda 2030 resolution on sustainable development, furthering her commitment to environmental and social issues.

In 2022, she founded the Finucci Foundation, a non-profit dedicated to using art to raise awareness about ocean pollution, social inequality, and the destruction of the planet. Finucci’s work has garnered numerous awards, and she was named Grand Officer of the Order of Merit of the Italian Republic in 2019.

Her work often repurposes materials from her installations, such as recycled plastic bottle caps, symbolizing both the problem of waste and the potential for creative reuse. Through Wasteland, Finucci continues to challenge the world to confront its environmental impact and to imagine a more sustainable future.

After the Ukrainian Revolution of 2014, he became involved as a human rights activist in the NGO ‘Committee for Combating Organised Crime and Corruption’, becoming Vice-President for the Volyn region. In 2015, he joined ‘Police 911’ (Ukrainian Rescue Service), serving as an officer and consultant for special rescue operations. In 2016, he became Vice President of the ‘International Anti-Corruption Assembly’ for Italy, moving to the country to take up the position.

Since 2019, Romanskyy has served as a volunteer in the Order of Malta’s Italian Relief Corps (Brescia Group) and, in 2020, he was appointed Head of the Italy Representative Office of the International Anti-Corruption Assembly. name: Pamela S. Evette
headline: Lieutenant Governor of South Carolina
bio:
Pamela S. Evette is the 93rd Lieutenant Governor of South Carolina.

Prior to her election as the first female Republican lieutenant governor of South Carolina, Evette founded Quality Business Solutions, Inc. (QBS), a payroll, human resources, and benefits services firm. Under her leadership, QBS grew from a start-up to one of the nation’s fastest growing small businesses.

Evette has received numerous accolades, including the ATHENA Leadership Award®. She has also been recognized for her efforts as a public servant on numerous issues including environmental, transportation, and humanitarian causes. In 2024, Evette was named a Christian Woman of Distinction by She Leads Carolinas, a She Leads Woman of Distinction by She Leads America, and received the Joseph H. Rainey Empowered Leadership Award.

As Lt. Governor, Evette has used her professional background to serve the people and businesses of South Carolina. She dedicates her time to highlighting S.C.’s thriving small business ecosystem and attracting new business to the Palmetto state. Evette is a staunch promoter of innovative public-private partnerships and works to bring greater awareness to S.C. non-profits and the impact they have in our local communities.

Beyond business, Evette has a passion for serving others — especially the most vulnerable in our society — which has guided her focus on early childhood education and reading. In 2019, she joined the sixth cohort of Hunt-Kean Leadership Fellows Program which focuses on state education policy.

Realizing every student has unique needs and goals, Evette is an advocate for school choice and promoter of S.C.’s world-class technical college system as pathways to educational and career success. In 2024, she launched her “Empowering Tomorrow’s Leaders” Initiative to get more young people working.

To highlight and protect S.C.’s natural resources, Evette created the Grab A Bag SC annual statewide litter clean-up initiative in partnership with PalmettoPride. She also joined the SC7 Expedition to raise awareness for floodwater prevention and continues to be involved in their efforts.

Evette serves on the boards of directors of the St Francis Foundation (affiliated with Bon Secours St. Francis Hospital) and the National Association of Professional Employer Organizations.

Evette is the granddaughter of Polish immigrants. Her parents, Jennie and Emil Gajoch, were first generation Americans who taught her the value of hard work and the importance of giving back. A devout Catholic, she and her husband David, attend Prince of Peace Catholic Church in Taylors. They have three children, Amanda, Joseph, and Jackson.

That there is always a solution.

name: Anita Winter
headline: Founder and President of “Gamaraal” Foundation in Zurich
bio:
Anita Winter, the daughter of two Holocaust survivors, is a dedicated advocate for Holocaust remembrance and human rights. Born in Switzerland, Winter has made it her life’s mission to ensure that the stories of Holocaust survivors are never forgotten. As the founder and president of the Gamaraal Foundation, she has provided both financial and emotional support to survivors, many of whom live in poverty and isolation. The foundation also promotes education about the Holocaust, aiming to pass down the lessons of history to future generations.

Winter’s journey into this humanitarian work was not immediate. She first had a successful career in the fashion industry, running her own clothing line, Anita S., and representing well-known labels. However, after the birth of her fourth child, she chose to focus on raising her family, planning to return to fashion later. By the time she was ready, the industry had changed, leading her to explore new professional challenges. The Women Back to Business (WBB) program inspired her to make bold decisions and rethink her career, which ultimately led to the creation of the Gamaraal Foundation.

For Winter, this foundation is not just a professional endeavor but a deeply personal one, driven by her commitment to honoring her parents’ survival and her belief in the power of education. Her work is influenced by her grandfather’s advice: “You can lose everything in life, except your education.” This philosophy has shaped her belief in the importance of education not only as a means of acquiring knowledge but also as a way to develop compassion and character.

Through initiatives such as the multimedia exhibition “The Last Swiss Holocaust Survivors,” Winter ensures that the stories of survivors are preserved and shared globally. She believes that peace can be achieved through education and small acts of kindness, inspired by figures like Mother Teresa. Winter’s work serves as a powerful reminder of the dangers of hatred and intolerance, as well as the importance of working toward a more just and compassionate world.

Her company group assists clients in obtaining EU grants for innovation projects. By ensuring her clients can effectively utilize both Polish and international legal frameworks, she enables them to foster innovation and achieve sustainable growth. Guided by international frameworks, including UN and EU regulations, her team advocates for creating inclusive, equitable work environments that value diverse perspectives. This approach ensures that the best ideas thrive, empowering businesses to succeed in today’s competitive landscape.

Anika Zanko’s extensive experience spans a wide array of legal fields, and she has built a reputation for her in-depth knowledge and pragmatic approach. She has honed her skills at leading law firms, where she has gained a wealth of experience in both national and international legal matters. Her expertise extends to representing clients in high-stakes international proceedings, including those before the European Court of Human Rights in Strasbourg.

A graduate of the prestigious Jagiellonian University in Kraków, Anika holds a degree from the Faculty of Law and has also studied at the School of American Law, in cooperation with the Catholic University of America Columbus School of Law. Her academic achievements include a scholarship at the University of Thessaloniki, as well as post-graduate studies in Penal Fiscal Law at the Jagiellonian University.

Zanko’s commitment to excellence in legal service and her vast international experience make her a highly sought-after advisor for clients navigating complex legal landscapes. As the leader of a dynamic team of lawyers, Anika is committed to fostering a work culture that champions gender equality and professional development. Rejecting hierarchical structures that stifle creativity, she promotes environments where diverse ideas and contributions are recognized and celebrated. name: Bonnie Carroll
headline: President and Founder of The Tragedy Assistance Program for Survivors (TAPS)
bio:
Bonnie Carroll is the founder of the Tragedy Assistance Program for Survivors (TAPS), established in 1994 to support those grieving the loss of a military loved one. Motivated by the death of her husband, Brigadier General Tom Carroll, in a 1992 Army plane crash, Bonnie turned personal tragedy into a mission to provide compassionate care to families of fallen military heroes. Under her leadership, TAPS has become the leading national organization offering peer-based emotional support, 24/7 helpline assistance, and resources to help navigate benefits and services.
Bonnie has held key government roles, including White House Liaison to the Department of Veterans Affairs under President George W. Bush and Executive Assistant to the President for Cabinet Affairs under President Reagan. She also co-founded TAPS Ukraine following the 2014 Russian invasion, offering support to Ukrainian families affected by the war. Bonnie retired as a major in the Air Force Reserve, where she served in various leadership roles, including Chief of Casualty Operations.
A respected advocate for military families, Bonnie has served on numerous boards and committees, including the Defense Health Board and the VA Advisory Committee on Families, Caregivers, and Survivors. She is a co-author of Healing Your Grieving Heart After a Military Death and has appeared on major national platforms discussing military grief.
Honored with the Presidential Medal of Freedom in 2015, Bonnie has received numerous awards, including the Army’s Outstanding Civilian Service Medal and the Navy’s Distinguished Public Service Award. She holds a degree in public administration and political science from American University and completed the Harvard University Executive Leadership Program in International Conflict Resolution.

He currently serves as President of the Pontifical Academy of Theology, where he works to promote theological reflection in service of the Church’s mission in the modern world.

Throughout his ecclesiastical and academic career, Monsignor Staglianò has combined pastoral ministry with teaching and research, focusing on systematic theology, communication of faith, and the role of theology in addressing contemporary social and cultural challenges. He is widely recognized for his ability to make theological concepts accessible and relevant to modern audiences.

In addition to his academic work, he has held several leadership positions within the Catholic Church, contributing to pastoral initiatives, education, and cultural engagement. His approach emphasizes dialogue between theology, philosophy, and the human experience, encouraging a deeper understanding of faith in everyday life.

H.E. Mons. Antonio Staglianò continues to be an influential voice in theological scholarship and ecclesial leadership, dedicated to fostering intellectual depth, spiritual renewal, and meaningful engagement between the Church and contemporary society.

name: Karen Floyd
headline: Founder of Elysian Media
bio:
Karen Floyd, founder of ELYSIAN Media, is an American publisher, filmmaker, and attorney from the state of South Carolina.
At ELYSIAN – an international women’s lifestyle magazine that launched in February 2016 – Floyd uses her vision and voice to guide an expanding audience in the realms of art, fashion, beauty, style and other women’s lifestyle issues. She oversees production of the quarterly print publication, weekly email newsletter, and all short- and long-form video projects.
ELYSIAN, whose motto is “Women Inspiring Women,” has evolved from a magazine for curious, adventurous and well-traveled women over 35 into a multimedia brand with print, digital, newsletter, events, television, film, app, and other components.
The brand has produced two fashion shows, kicking off New York Fashion Week in February 2023 and September 2024. These one-of-a-kind exhibitions team models, designers from all over the world, rescue animals and charities across the United States, and three cash prizes are given.
ELYSIAN, too, has produced three documentaries – one on the inaugural CatWalk FurBaby, and two on the war in Ukraine. 12 Women’s War, which highlights the perspectives of women from all walks of life, won 10 international film festival awards. Floyd met these women on the ground and along the front lines of Ukraine in early 2023.
She was so moved by the stories of the women, children and soldiers that she returned to Ukraine later in 2023 with a small team to film Ukraine: For the Children. The 93-minute film debuted at an exclusive private screening at the American Theater in Charleston, South Carolina, on July 30, 2024. An abbreviated cut of the film was screened at the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C., earlier in the year.
A driven entrepreneur, Floyd has the unique ability to understand clients’ goals and develop strategies and solutions that are engaging and deliver results. She has raised more than $45 million for for-profits and not-for-profits. She is a recipient of The Order of the Palmetto, the highest civilian honor in South Carolina. Floyd is a former prosecutor and was the first woman in South Carolina to serve as chief magistrate judge. She later became the first woman to serve as chair of Spartanburg County Council, the state's fourth-largest county. She earned her juris doctorate from the University of South Carolina School of Law, where she served as president of the student bar.

Yacov Crawford is a results-driven leader with extensive multi-sector experience in driving strategic, data-driven solutions for impactful businesses and communities.

Throughout his career, he has collaborated with businesses, government entities, and civil society to create sustainable, long-term solutions that address systemic challenges. His research and work in impact evaluation, systems mapping, and community-based participatory research have helped numerous organizations balance financial performance with social responsibility. By designing transformative performance methodologies that align investments with measurable social outcomes, he ensures that funds—whether from businesses, foundations, or non-profits—are directed to areas that generate the most meaningful impact. Through his family business, Social Change Ventures, Yacov has helped develop methodologies that translate actionable data into real-world situations, benefiting the public, private, and non-profit sectors alike.

Yacov specializes in leveraging both qualitative and quantitative non-traditional data sources to guide investments for maximum social return. His expertise extends beyond the private sector, as he also works closely with governments, foundations, and not-for-profit organizations, helping them measure and demonstrate the impact of their investments and efforts. Yacov advised the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (UNOCHA) on creating a successful technology and evaluation lab and worked on developing strategies for diversifying funding sources for sustainable programming.

He was also an invited member of the Federal Charlotte Financial Crimes Task Force. Yacov is published in both peer-reviewed and non-peer-reviewed publications, contributing to discussions on social impact, public safety, and community resilience. bio:

After working as a software engineer for giant corporations such as Disney, Microsoft, and Amazon, Ridvan Aliu founded his own software consulting firm in 2010 called Real Visualz LLC (realvisualz.com). Real Visualz grew from 3 to 30+ engineers within a year, working on world-class projects such as the Coca Cola Freestyle machine, Ford navigation system, Amazon instant video player, among many others.

bio:
Diambi Kabatsuila was crowned as the ruler of the Bena Tshiyamba People of the Bakwa Indu of Central Kasai Region part of the ancient Luba Empire in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) on August 31, 2016.

All the Bakwa Lunta Chiefs enthroned her on July 15, 2017. She now holds the title ofDiambi Mukalenga Mukaji Wa Nkashama Wa Bakwa Lunta (Queen of the Order of the Leopard). The Association of Congo Traditional and Customary Authorities invested her in Kinshasa on August 5, 2017.

On March 3, 2019, the queen was crowned in Salvador, Bahia, Queen Mother of the Bantu People of Brazil, the Historical African Diaspora, which has a population of nearly 90 million. The queen also has been awarded with the title of Grande Mae do Povo Bantu do Brasileiro and has received the Tiradentes Medal, highest honour from Parliament in Brazil in March 2019.

Although born in Belgium to a Belgium mother and Con­ golese father who was a diplomat, She grew up in Kinsha­ sa in the DRC. Queen Diambi holds a Doctorate in Public Administration and a Doctorate of Philosophy in Human­ ities, a Professorship in International Law and Order, A Master of Science in Applied Psychology and Mental Health Counselling. Queen Diambi has consecrated much time mastering issues relating to trauma and how it affects identity. She is a trained EMDR therapist and holds a Degree as a Practitioner of Complementary and Alternative Medicine. Queen Diambi is also a certified Math and French Teacher and holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Finance and Economics. For several years she worked as an economic consultant with the Observatoire Social Europeen in Brussels for the European Commission and other governmental agencies in the EU.

Queen Diambi is the Founder and Executive Director of the Elikia Hope Foundation and heads her Private Family office that invests and promotes those values and causes that she champions.

Apart from this she sits on various advisory boards of foundations, charities and international organisations around the world.

From a young age, Queen Diambi was interested in all matters concerning the restoration of the African identity through the study of history and of the cultural traditional heritage of the continent and beyond. One of her main projects, besides the enterprise of rural development of Central Kesa1 is to seek alliances to correct the narrative about African people. The resto­ ration of the African identity will come by encouraging the masses to learn about their true history and by promoting the appreciation of the African ancestral heritage in cultures, languages, folklore and traditions, all of which place the greatest value on compassion, respect, solidarity and the primordial role of creator in all aspects of existence. Queen Diambi strongly believes in fostering a culture of peace in the world. Her and Her royal court advo­ cates a compassionate attitude, mutual respect and desire for understanding people who are different and who often have opposing interests. The will and the decision to reach out to others with an open heart to highlight similarities in fundamental needs, concerns, values, and aspirations is the premise of friendships, peace, and prosperity for all

Board Experience and Certification

acquisition firm. Keith is also a member of the Executive Leadership Council (ELC) and a Santa Clara University’s Black Corporate
Board Readiness program graduate.
Corporate Experience

firm with 75 offices in 45 countries. His work focuses on helping boards by providing a comprehensive set of board consulting
services, including full-scale governance review, board, committee, and director assessments, M&A governance planning, board
refreshment, and CEO succession planning.
In his former role as President and Executive Advisor for Dorsey Management Consulting, he mentored and advised CxOs on their
sales growth and go-to-market strategies, helped businesses align their strategy with sales expectations, aggressively grow their bottom
line and shareholder value during significant periods of change, optimize leadership and sales team effectiveness.
He has over 25 years of sales leadership experience in the Human Capital Management industry, such as at Alight Solutions (formerly
Aon Hewitt and Hewitt Associates), a $2.3B leading provider of human capital solutions where he served as the Executive Vice
President, Global Head of Sales responsible for the overall sales growth strategy and execution. Under Keith’s executive leadership,
his sales teams consistently produced double-digit annual growth. Prior to joining Hewitt Associates, Keith worked with Paychex, Inc.,
a Fortune 1000 payroll and HR outsourcing company, for 16 years. He was a Zone Sales Manager responsible for the growth and
delivery of revenue in their Human Resource Service Division. Before Paychex, Keith spent three years in the insurance industry and
five years serving his country in the U.S. Air Force.
Education

research is around the lack of gender and ethnic diversity on corporate boards. He also has an MBA from Pepperdine University and
a BS in Business Administration from Charter Oak State College.

Former British diplomat and policy adviser on conflict issues for Oxfam, an international charity, Julia Golding is now best known as a multi-award-winning author of over sixty novels for adults and children. She has won awards in the UK and USA, including the Waterstones’ Children’s Book of the Year, the Nestlé Book Prize, and the Romantic Novelist Association Prize. Her books have been translated into over twenty languages and sold more than a million copies worldwide. She writes under two other pseudonyms, Joss Stirling and Eve Edwards. This year she has launched a new historical thriller series with HarperCollins.
She has written extensively on science and faith for children in the series The Curious Science Quest with Professor Andrew Briggs and artist Roger Wagner. This led to a play on the first female scientist of the modern age, Caroline Herschel, called Queen of the Night, an inspiring story of struggle against the odds. It had its first performance in Bath in 2023. Julia is looking for opportunities for a full staging so do get in touch if you are interested. Julia is also working on four screenwriting projects with Full Table Productions, Zero Gravity and Wild Mercury.
Julia established in 2021 and runs the Oxford Centre for Fantasy, which is dedicated to Tolkien and his fellow Inklings. The centre has a weekly podcast ‘Mythmakers’, covering matters interesting to fantasy fans and fantasy creatives. The centre runs creative writing courses, a novel prize for debut authors, and has a house for scholars in road where Tolkien was living when he wrote his most famous books. For more information go to www.oxfordcentreforfantasy.org
Golding also hosts the podcast ‘What Would Jane Do?’ now in its fifth season, where she and fellow Austen expert Kate MacFarlane take a Regency perspective on modern day issues and report any Jane Austen news to the fanbase.

She has a doctorate in English Literature of the Romantic Era from Oxford University.
Married with three grown-up children, she lives in a beautiful village near Oxford.

name: Maria Amata Garito
headline: President of the International Telematic University -UNINETTUNO
bio:
Maria Amata Garito is Professor Emeritus of Psychotechnologies and President and Rector of the International Telematic University UNINETTUNO.
From 1994 to 2013 she worked as full professor of Psychotechnologies at the Psychology Faculty of the University of Rome “La Sapienza” and for some years also at the Sorbonne University in Paris. She was Director General of CATTID (Center for Applications of Television and Technologies of Distance Education) at “La Sapienza” University of Rome from 1984 to 1990. The results of her research activities related to technologies and artificial intelligence applied to teaching and learning processes enabled her to create:

Consorzio NETTUNO – Network Telematico per l’Università Ovunque – in which she had the role of Director General from 1991 to 2016 and she realized the organizational and of distance teaching model of Consorzio NETTUNO.
In 2005 she established the International Telematic University UNINETTUNO and designed and realized its psycho-pedagogical, organizational models and its technological platform.
He was scientific advisor for Teaching and Learning Technologies, Distance Education, Technological Innovation and Relations with Mediterranean Countries to several Italian University Ministers.
As an expert, he was member of several scientific committees at the European Commission for designing the guidelines to be applied to the development of research programs on new technologies applied to teaching and learning processes.
Her collaboration engagement with countries in the Euro-Mediterranean Area are ongoing and began in 2001 as coordinator and director general of the Med-Net’U – Mediterranean Network of Universities – Project in the framework the EUMEDIS Program of European Commission.
For UNESCO, in 2002, she designed the organizational and psycho-pedagogic model of the Arab Open University in Kuwait.
From 2009 to 2012 she designed and realized the new psycho-pedagogic-didactic model to create a video course and related textbooks whose title was: “I Learn Arabic – The Treasure of the Letters” to teach to read and write in Arabic to adult illiterate people in Morocco. This course is broadcast by the national television of Morocco. In 2015-16 she realized the Distance University for Refugees in which all refugees and migrants who wish so, from anywhere across the world, can enroll in UNINETTUNO University for free.

She conducted several international research activities; she authored about 200 scientific publications and received many international prizes and awards.

name: Daniele Tedeschi
headline: Scientific Director of Genobioma
bio:
Dr Daniele Tedeschi, Scientific Director of Genobioma is going to be one of the speakers at “World Changers Summit 2023” an event that will bring together international leaders and entrepreneurs from all over the world from the fields of biohacking, advanced medicine, robotic, wellness, etc…

Dr Tedeschi Biologist PhD and postdoctoral researcher, has Sicilian origins and his professional and scientific upgrade is Tuscan (Pisa, which he considers his second birthplace), he has a very long curriculum in different fields of Biological Science: neurology pharmacology andrology reproductive medicine endocrinology oncology cardiovascular diseases. He is founder and scientific director of GENOBIOMA, the Italian company that uses the reports of genetic polymorphisms from exome (coding DNA) with complex bioinformatics studies from big data of all significant genetic variants aimed at a predictive medicine model, as well as at the improvement of pharmacogenomics and nutrigenomics for advanced and precision medicine.

Over 10 years ago he decided to read whole DNA and not just a few genes or limited panels that give partial information on one or more metabolic pathways. Dr. Tedeschi believes that only the knowledge of the whole DNA can provide the closest information to predictive risk factors. Reading only a frame of DNA you run the risk of reading a book of which you will never know the killer or the future killer or, worse, to interpret not the original instigator but only the material executor (today the clinic is increasingly symptomatic and less and less in search of the etiopathology of the problem).

Dr. Tedeschi uses techniques of interaction between bio-softwares trying to arrive at a single bioinformatic solution for the reading and interpretation of the DNA exome, integrating almost exclusively what one or more critical metabolic pathways use physiologically, thus distinguishing between physiological integrations the natural ones and the xenobiotic ones (drugs). This allows not only a functional variation of DNA, but a physiological functional variation to restore metabolic and therefore critical genomic activities without adverse reactions and above all using only what is necessary and not what sometimes from a less in-depth analysis may seem useful.

He is currently a pioneer in the use and practical application of predictive medicine and pharmacogenomics, particularly in cardiovascular diseases – neurodegenerative disorders and immunity (autoimmunity and allergies) among the main pathologies that afflict people’s daily lives today and that make that dash in the middle between life and death less serenely livable.

headline: MD President of International Association for Orthomolecular Medicine & Founder of Robotic & Regenerative Society
bio:
Prof.Dr. Adolfo Panfili, a medical doctor and surgeon, holds degrees in Psychology, Sociology, and Chiropractic. He is also an Acupuncturist, Homeopath, Homotoxicologist, and Phytotherapist, serving as the President of the International Association of Orthomolecular Medicine (AIMO). He is a renowned orthopedic surgeon with a distinguished international career.

As the founder and president of AIMO, he has been a key figure in the progress of orthomolecular medicine and, according to a random survey, is considered one of the physicians with the most extensive interdisciplinary expertise worldwide.

Initiated by his mentor, double Nobel laureate Prof. Linus Pauling, he has expanded the scope of orthomolecular sciences by integrating it with other disciplines, such as the use of ADSC and stem cells, Stromal Vascular Fraction (SVF), in regenerative medicine.

In addition to his commitment to orthomolecular medicine, Prof. Panfili holds several prestigious academic positions. He was previously the Vice-Rector and Dean of the Faculty of Sustainable Orthomolecular Sciences at the University of Arezzo and later at the Popular University of Milan since 2015.

He was the first surgeon in Italy to perform minimally invasive robotic orthopedic surgery using the Mazor system. He currently leads advanced centers for minimally invasive spinal surgery in both the Italian National Health Service (NHS) and private institutions. He is the founder and director of the first Italian Center for Minimally Invasive Robotic Spine Surgery and a prominent member of the International Academy for Robotic Spine Surgery.

With over 40 years of experience, Prof. Panfili has been a pioneer in the orthomolecular treatment of the spine, posture, and nutrition, combining surgical expertise with manipulative therapies. He was the first orthopedic surgeon in Europe to earn a degree in Best Chiropractic under the guidance of the renowned chiropractor Prof. Ted Morter, being recognized as the best European student.

Currently, Prof. Panfili is at the forefront of using Stromal Vascular Fraction for therapies related to wellness, anti-aging, and longevity, with a particular focus on orthopedic applications. His work centers on the prevention of degenerative diseases affecting hips, knees, and intervertebral discs, making significant strides in regenerative medicine and cartilage repair.

Prof. Panfili lectures and conducts training worldwide for large national, multinational organizations, and governments. He collaborates with engineer Pietro Lorenzetti on the *Orthomolecular Hydroponic* project, a method that uses amino acids, minerals, and vitamins to nourish plants and correct metabolic imbalances associated with various diseases. He also provides medical, postural, and nutritional support for astronauts and Olympic athletes.

With over 30 published works, his ideas have sparked a cultural revolution in the medical field, orthomolecular biohacking, and global agricultural planning. His operational plan is based on three fundamental pillars: healthcare, agriculture, and education, with the goal of making Earth a better planet for future generations. (www.adolfopanfili.it)

Specializing in the intersection of elementary particle physics and cosmology, Prof. Krauss’s research delves into the origins and evolution of the universe and the underlying structure of matter. His groundbreaking 1995 proposal that the universe’s dominant energy resides in empty space was substantiated in 1998, earning a Nobel Prize in 2011.

Prof. Krauss’s impact on science extends beyond research. He is the author of twelve best-selling popular science books and has contributed to over 300 scientific papers. His writings, celebrated for their eloquence, often appear in respected magazines and newspapers, connecting with audiences worldwide.

A renowned science communicator, Prof. Krauss’s reach extends to various media platforms, including radio and television. His influential role in public discourse even includes appearances in films. He has been recognized with prestigious awards from three U.S. physics societies and received the notable Public Service Award from the US National Science Board for his unwavering commitment to scientific education and outreach.

Currently, he serves as president of the Origins Project Foundation and hosts The Origins Podcast with Lawrence Krauss. Further exemplifying his esteemed status in the scientific community, Prof. Krauss has been elected as a Fellow of both the American Physical Society and the American Association for the Advancement of Science.

As regards the logistics and infrastructure sectors, she has been Head of Communications for the Venice Port Authority; Media Relations Consultant for Aeroporti di Roma; International PR Advisor for Atlantia; while Vice-President at FBC.

Patrizia is a Contract Professor in Leadership and International Relations at the IULM University of Milan and has a degree in Law and International Political Science.

name: Prof. GIUSEPPE TEDESCHI
headline: Protocol Master
bio:
Tedeschi began his artistic-pictorial training from a very young age both with the study of drawing and painting and restoration techniques (with Roman school masters). He graduated in Painting at the Academy of Fine Arts in Rome, with the Masters Ziveri (first two years) and Avenali (second biennium) in 1981. His thesis was in art history entitled “History of costume and clothing through painting from the 16th to the 18th century “. He specialized, at the Academy of Fine Arts in Rome in Artistic Anatomy, Engraving Techniques, Art History, Theory of Perception and Psychology of Form, Pedagogy and Teaching, Photography, Design and Various Sculpture Techniques. He won the state competition for the role of teaching in the State School (Competition class XXXIV / A) for Artistic Education. Over his professional career, he has participated in numerous exhibitions and reviews, obtaining significant recognition from nationally renowned institutions and made numerous official portraits located in the Vatican. His artistic works have also appeared in historical embassies such as the Spanish Embassy to the Holy See Palazzo di Spagna, in official palaces and galleries such as the Boncompagni Ludovisi portrait gallery, the Palazzo Altieri collection of the Finnat Bank, the military ordinariate of Rome, the convent of Trinità dei Monti above Piazza di Spagna in Rome, and others including private collections.

He had the prestigious honor of having His Holiness Pope Francis donate one of his works, the icon of St. Francis of Assisi, to the Franciscans of Ireland on his historic visit to that country.

Additionally, he is the Master Painter of Metaformismo ®, a leading exponent of the Metaformismo movement created by Prof. and art critic Giulia Sillato, and has participated in many national and international exhibitions.
excerpt: Conte Gr. Cr. Prof. Dott. Giuseppe Tedeschi was appointed ‘Attaché of the Antechamber of His Holiness’ and nominated in this office in the Pontifical Family by His Holiness Saint John Paul II on 18 November 1986. For this reason, his office has taken part in state visits since 1986 including receiving heads state government, ambassadors, and Papal functions and ceremonies at the Holy City.

name: SLAVA KABANTSEV
headline: WCS
bio:
From Odessa, Ukraine, he graduated from the Odessa National Maritime Academy and started working in politics, where he received a diploma in political science as a “young politician”. He worked with top businessmen and politicians. He started his business in the agricultural and wood fields, as he was also the owner of an IT and commercial business. In 2015, seeking new opportunities and challenges, he moved to the UAE.

There he created the Event Agency Galaxias 2017, which gave him oxygen and new opportunities for a new life. Slava Kabantsev worked with royal families around the GCC countries. Companies like Damac, Emaar, Nakheel, Mercedes, Maserati, AXA, FIFA, F1, MAN, government sectors, Dragon Oil, etc.

In 2020, following COVID and the subsequent economic crisis, his business went bankrupt. After two years of hard work, Mr. Kabantsev incredibly regained his prominent position. In 2021, he was invited to be Advisor to the Chairman of the Private Office of Sheikh Saqr Bin Muhammad Al Qasimi, one of the biggest business conglomerates in the UAE with a history spanning more than a decade and multiple projects such as manufacturing, trade and supply, real estate, services provided in real estate, information technology, oil and gas, sports, recruitment, and financial services.

Today, Slava Kabantsev continues working together with the founder of the Future Innovation Summit and Groups of Companies under Leadership Adnan Al Noorani.

For his cooperative work and perseverance, he has received a title of recognition from the Institute for Advance Studies and Cooperation, becoming the institute’s special project advisor in the UAE and Middle East area.

He was also honored by His Excellency Mons. Bracamonte of the Roman Catholic Church with the medal of San Juan de Capistrano.

Slava Kabantsev now owns some businesses:

  • Founder of an event company, Najm Allail
  • Founding Partner: SK Group of Companies
  • Founding Partner Mag
  • azine Expat
  • Founding Partners: Digital Radio Expat and 7 Friends
  • Co-founder of the S2UP competition
  • Co-Founder of the World Changers Event and Founding Partner of The Consultancy Solved” and Project BioHacking” with Professor Gabriele Pao-Pei Andreoli
  • Producer and Founder of New TV Shows, which will become “THE” and K2 in 2023.

In the meantime, Mr. Kabantsev has become one of the co-creators of the “World Changers Summit 2023,” which will be held this July 5th, at the Pontifical Academy of Sciences in the Vatican City.

“In this moment of crisis, I realized it was also an opportunity for the international community to get together, so I decided to work for a better future, finding real solutions and leading the way. So, we founded the World Changers Summit,” said Mr. Kabantsev.
excerpt: Slava Kabantsev is an entrepreneur and businessman with more than 15 years of experience in the high-tech industry. investment, politics, and events. Experience in establishing companies, managing breakthrough projects, and creating cutting-edge solutions. He is an advisor to entrepreneurs and companies, specializing in early-stage investments and strategic alliances.
